rows.proof: `BOARD OF ASSESSORS`, PDF page 12 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed page 9). TABLE 1 of five, headed `Fiscal 2011 Assessments and Revenues by Major Property Class`. The printed column header, verbatim and in order: `Property Class` | `Levy Percent` | `Valuation by Class` | `Tax Rate` | `Tax Levy`. Open Space prints `-0-` in both money columns -- an explicit zero, recorded as 0. THREE identities close on this page and they are independent of one another: (a) the five levy percentages sum to the printed `100.0000`; (b) the five tax levies sum to the printed `18,006,811.48` to the cent; (c) each class's valuation at the printed rate of 16.16 per thousand reproduces that class's printed tax levy to the cent -- 1,000,004,500 x 16.16/1000 = 16,160,072.72, 64,514,700 -> 1,042,557.55, 21,614,900 -> 349,296.78, 28,148,789 -> 454,884.43. THE PAGE'S OWN TOTALS CELL FOR VALUATION IS MISPRINTED. It reads `1,114,2828,889` -- ten digits, which no reading of the five components produces and which is not a number the town uses anywhere else. Verified by re-reading the cell at 6x: the characters are `1,114,2828,889`. The total used here, 1,114,282,889, is the figure the SAME PAGE prints twice more: the `Valuation and Tax History` row for 2011 (`Total Valuation 1,114,282,889`) and the `Fiscal Year 2011 Abstract of Assessments` TOTALS row. The five components sum to it exactly. So the total is read off the document, not inferred, and the garbled cell is recorded as a defect in the published report rather than corrected into the figures.

rows.proof: `CAPITAL PLANNING COMMITTEE`, PDF page 14 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folio 11). The table under the sentence `The following items were presented in the Plan.` PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM: `Department` | `Item` | `Amount`. Twelve rows. THIS PAGE WAS NOT IN `annual-report-pages.csv` AND WAS FOUND BY THE EXTENT SWEEP. A page enters that tracker on fifteen recognised money figures and this one carries twelve, so it was ABSENT rather than unfinished -- the pattern CLAUDE.md rule 13c describes and which has now cost five years a page each. Of the twelve pages of this report that hold money figures and are not in the tracker, this is the only one that is a TABLE; pages 6-8 are officer lists whose figures are expiry years, pages 26, 42 and 47-49 are prose, and pages 81-83 are town-meeting warrant excerpts that state sums in sentences rather than in a table. THIS PAGE PRINTS NO TOTAL AND NOTHING HERE PROVES ITS DIGITS. There is no arithmetic on the page to close and no second printing of these twelve amounts anywhere in this report, so the check declared is COVERAGE ONLY: every printed row carries exactly one figure. That asserts the SHAPE -- a figure lost, doubled or split would break it -- and it is powerless against a misread digit. The twelve amounts sum to 538,765.00, which is OUR arithmetic and is not stated anywhere on the page; it is recorded in this sentence and deliberately not as a `total` row, because a total we computed is not a total the document prints. WHAT THIS IS NOT. These are items PRESENTED in the capital plan, and the page's own prose says so: `The items placed in the budget were Technology, Police vests (1/2 paid by grants), and cruiser equipment. The items placed under borrowing were DPW- loader, Fire- Engine 2 refit and radios, MS- Parking Lot, THMS- whiteboards, bleachers and gym floor, HS- Asbestos Abatement and ADA Access.` So a row here is a request, not an appropriation and not a payment, and it may not be differenced against the capital project fund balances on page 71 or the voted omnibus budget on pages 84-85. Rows are keyed by printed position; `Technology`, `Police`, `Fire`, `School, High` and `School, THMS` each name two consecutive rows.

rows.proof: `FY 2011 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2011`, PDF page 58 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folio 55). THE PAGE IS SCANNED UPSIDE DOWN and must be rotated 180 degrees to be read; so is page 73. Nothing in the archive flagged either. The page prints a long detail list in two columns under ten block headings -- `TAXES & EXCISES:`, `INTEREST:`, `DEMANDS:`, `FEES:`, `DEPARTMENTAL REVENUE:`, `LICENSES/PERMITS:`, `STATE REVENUE:`, `FINES & FORFEITS:`, `EARNINGS ON INVESTMENTS:` and an unheaded block -- and then a `SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS` block of nine categories footed to a printed `GRAND TOTAL`. WHAT PROVES THIS FILE: the nine summary categories sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL of 27,388,537.87 to the cent, with no tolerance. That is the identity the page states about itself and it is what the `fund` rows here carry. THE DETAIL LINES ARE RECORDED AS `line` ROWS AND ARE NOT SUMMED, BECAUSE THE PAGE DOES NOT SAY WHICH CATEGORY MOST OF THEM BELONG TO. The block headings are not the summary categories: there are ten blocks and nine categories, one block has no heading at all, and `FEES` names both a block and a category without the two agreeing. Of the nine categories, FIVE can be reproduced from the printed detail and FOUR cannot: (a) LICENSES AND PERMITS 302,867.40 is exactly the seventeen lines under `LICENSES/PERMITS:`; (b) STATE REVENUE 6,094,397.10 is exactly the eight lines under `STATE REVENUE:`; (c) SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS 72,936.21 is exactly five lines of the UNHEADED block -- TRAILER PARKS 14,364.00, MEADOW WOODS WATER BETT PRINC 6,438.50 and INTEREST 34,589.94, STREET BETTERMENTS 9,398.94 and STREET BETTERMENT INTEREST 8,144.83 -- and NOT the sixth line of that block, RESCUE WAGON 265,514.34; (d) INVESTMENT INCOME 21,358.21 and (e) TRANSFER FROM OTHER FUNDS 1,057,329.00 are each a single printed line. THE FOUR THAT DO NOT RECONCILE, with their residuals and no explanation attached: TAXES & EXCISES -- the thirteen lines under `TAXES & EXCISES:`, `INTEREST:` and `DEMANDS:` plus PENALTY/INTEREST TAX LIENS and PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAXES sum to 19,257,380.20 against a printed 19,233,433.01, OVER by 23,947.19. That residual happens to equal the printed SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION line to the cent. NOTHING HERE ESTABLISHES THAT THAT LINE IS THE CAUSE -- a residual equal to one plausible line is exactly the coincidence CLAUDE.md rule 14 warns against reading as a finding, and no figure has been moved or dropped to make the category close. FINES & FORFEITS -- the three printed lines sum to 30,346.00 against a printed 32,371.00, SHORT by 2,025.00, and the page prints no fourth fine. FEES 502,520.65 and NON RECURRING REVENUE 71,325.29 cannot be reconstructed from the printed detail by any grouping the page states. Every detail figure on the page is captured here, so the limit is the page's and not the reading's. Rows are keyed by printed position within their block; `fund_name` carries the block heading followed by the printed label.

rows.proof: THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER, READ OFF THIS PAGE (rule 13b.4): `PROGRAM NAME` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE` | `TOTAL EXPENDED` | `TOTAL ENCUMBERED` | `BALANCE TO REVENUE`, under the heading `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2011`. WHY THAT HEADER MATTERS HERE. CLAUDE.md rule 13 names FY2011 as this archive's worked example of a check with no power to fail: `v1` in the generic annual-report extracts means THE FIRST COLUMN OF THIS PAGE THAT HELD FIGURES, the ruler is built per page, and summing v1 across a run adds one page's APPROPRIATED to another's TOTAL EXPENDED -- FY2011 came out within 1% of its own printed total that way. On every appropriations page of this report the first money column is `APPROPRIATED FORWARD`: an appropriation, or a prior-year carry-forward where the cell is followed by the word `fwd`, or a short-term borrowing where it is followed by `srt`. HOW THE TABLE IS SHAPED. Each department prints its line items (Payroll, Other Expenses, and where it applies a bare carry-forward or short-term borrowing on the heading row) and then an UNLABELLED rule-and-total row carrying up to all five columns. The line items are recorded here as `line` rows, so they are published and NOT summed and NOT identity-checked; the department total rows are the `fund` rows and carry the check. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION: `Payroll` and `Other Expenses` are printed under almost every department, so `fund_number` is the department's ordinal down the page and, for a line item, that ordinal plus the item's ordinal within the department. Nothing on this page is keyed on a printed name. A department whose total row prints no `BALANCE TO REVENUE` cell is left with NO VALUE in that column rather than a zero, so nothing asserts an identity the page does not state (the FY2014 case where absent was scored as zero and read as the town's arithmetic failing). WHY THIS PAGE WAS READ AT ALL. It was already marked `proven` in the page tracker and had NO page-read behind it, while every one of its rows in the generic extract `report-appropriations.csv` carries `status = check failed`. A page proven by nothing that can fail is the shape rule 13 warns about, and FY2011's appropriations run is the archive's own named case of it. Pages 61 and 62 of this run were read earlier; 60, 63, 64 and 65 were not. WHAT PROVES IT. The page prints no grand total, so the proof is the identity the table states about itself on every department total row -- total funds available less total expended less total encumbered is the balance returned to revenue -- DECLARED here and re-asserted by `verify_page_reads.py` on every run. BEYOND THAT, and recomputed by the generator before it would write anything, every department's LINE ITEMS foot to its own total row in each of the four money columns the department prints: 35 column-ties across 12 departments on this page, all closing to the cent. The generator REFUSES to write if any one of them misses. THE PAGE'S OWN ODDITIES, TRANSCRIBED AS PRINTED. `Town Manager` and `Town Accountant` each print a bare figure on the department heading row followed by `srt` -- a short-term borrowing -- and `Tax Collector's Administration` and `Treasurer's Administration` each print one followed by `fwd`, a prior-year carry-forward; all four are recorded as line items named for the word the page prints beside them, and all four are needed for the APPROPRIATED FORWARD column to foot. `8/10 ATM Audit Personal Property Records` is a single article row with no line items beneath it and is recorded as a `fund` row with the five figures it prints. `Annual Audit` prints a total row with THREE columns and NO `TOTAL ENCUMBERED` and NO `BALANCE TO REVENUE` cell, so no identity is asserted on it and the verifier names it as a row printing no total rather than counting it as a failure. The page is the FIRST of the FY2011 appropriations run, printed folio 57, heading `GENERAL GOVERNMENT`.
